description: This file is a PHP web page that manages and displays information about LAN Ethernet ports on a network gateway device. It includes PHP code for fetching device information, generating HTML to display port statuses, and JavaScript for interactive configuration (such as enabling or disabling a port). It also includes template includes for header, footer, and navigation elements.

methods.name: getPort4XHSEnabled
methods.description: Function to determine if the 4XHS port is enabled based on device parameters.

methods.name: NameMap
methods.description: Helper function for mapping Ethernet port statuses to display strings, considering device operational modes.
